title: 第2552章 自作孽不可活疯狂报复第2551章 算计全是算计调戏钟默离
content_zh:
众人在来这地殿路上，就关闭电子信号谨防追踪。
到达这深埋地下始祖宫殿，更是与世隔绝半点信号连不上。
只能用最古老的信鸽通信方式，与留在外面打探消息，冒死收集情报精英血族沟通。
本以为还要过两天。
等教会、骑士做出是战是和重大决策，才会有重大消息传回，却这么快就收到信鸽。
不是外面出大事。
不可能做这么冒险举动。
动静一出人影一现，不等那执勤血卫来到跟前，负责侦查搜集任务瓦格罗趋身上前。
接过信鸽紧急询问：
“怎么回事？”
“哪里来的秘信？”
血卫守在地殿外面据点，负责接受信息禀报。
却回答不上来。
神色焦急：
“不清楚。”
“这信鸽上布有高阶血族密钥，我血境低解不开。”
“得您来。”
高阶！
瓦格罗一族掌握五感、兽化两条血族秩序，是八大家族中最会干侦查收集情报之族群。
为打探到教会、骑士动向。

她一口气派出数个瓦格罗家族精英，覆盖男爵到侯爵。
眼前接信之守卫也是她瓦格罗家的人，实力在伯爵。
却解不开信鸽上血钥。
说明什么？
送信的是她最最看重，最不能暴露之侯爵。
心中生出不祥想法，刺激的她抓信鸽的手都微微颤抖。
当着全部人面。
从掌心长出血针小心刺入白鸽脑袋，忐忑不安接收信息。
一秒。
两秒.......
连她亲王都控制不住，万分紧张姿态流露。
迅速感染整个地下宫殿。
几十双眼睛紧盯住她，她却越接收面容越放松。
逐渐往喜笑颜开转变。
看得地殿众人都松口气同时，心中好奇心狂冒。
焦急等待不到十秒。
用血族秘法藏于白鸽脑子中秘信，被瓦格罗清晰完整接收。
content_en:
On the way to this underground palace, everyone turned off their electronic signals to prevent tracking.
When we arrived at the ancestral palace buried deep underground, we were even more isolated from the rest of the world, with no signal at all.
They can only use the oldest communication method of carrier pigeons to communicate with the elite vampires who stay outside to inquire about information and risk their lives to collect intelligence.
I thought it would take another two days.
The church and knights would have to wait until the church and knights made important decisions about war or war before any major news would be sent back, but they received a carrier pigeon so quickly.
It's not that something big happened outside.
It is impossible to do such a risky move.
As soon as there was movement, figures appeared, and without waiting for the blood guard on duty to arrive, Vaguero, who was responsible for the investigation and collection mission, stepped forward.
Received the carrier pigeon and asked urgently:
"What's going on?"
"Where did the secret message come from?"
The blood guards guard the stronghold outside the underground palace and are responsible for receiving information reports.
But couldn't answer.
Looking anxious:
"Not sure."
"This carrier pigeon is covered with a high-level bloodline key, which I, with a low blood level, cannot unlock."
"You have to come."
High level!
The Vaguero clan masters the two blood clan orders of five senses and animal transformation. They are the most capable of investigating and gathering intelligence among the eight major families.
In order to find out the movements of the church and knights.
She sent out several Vaguero family elites in one go, covering barons to marquises.
The guard receiving the letter in front of her is also a member of her Vaguero family, and her strength is greater than that of the earl.
But he couldn't unlock the blood key on the homing pigeon.
What does it mean?
The person who sent the letter was the Marquis whom she valued most and could not be exposed the most.
Ominous thoughts came to her mind, which made her hand holding the pigeon tremble slightly.
In front of everyone.
A bleeding needle sprouted from the palm of his hand and he carefully pierced the white pigeon's head, receiving the message anxiously.
One second.
Two seconds.......
Even her prince couldn't control it, and his extremely nervous posture showed.
Quickly infected the entire underground palace.
Dozens of pairs of eyes stared at her, but her face became more relaxed as she accepted it.
Gradually change to a smile.
Seeing that everyone in the underground palace breathed a sigh of relief, curiosity arose in their hearts.
The anxious wait was less than ten seconds.
The secret message was hidden in Bai Ge's mind using the secret method of the blood clan, and was clearly and completely received by Vaguero.
